`dsem_compute()` uses scheduler-aware core detection. Independent chains run in
separate R processes; Rust kernels never call the R API from worker threads.

```{r}
library(DSEMr)
dsem_compute()
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
compute <- dsem_compute(workers = 4, backend = "psock", threads = 1)
fit <- dsem(model, data, chains = 4, compute = compute, seed = 4815)
```

On Slurm, request resources with `--cpus-per-task` and do not request more DSEMr
workers than allocated. PBS/TORQUE, SGE, and LSF variables are also recognized
through `parallelly`.
